description: Tier-2 PSLQ extension over hyperbolic knots from SnapPy at high precision (≥60 dps). All basis values now come from SnapPy directly (replacing earlier hardcoded atlas constants which had ≤5 sig figs for K_11a259 / L_11a62 and contained transcription errors for several other knots). Tests whether 2/(3π) lies in the integer-multiple lattice of these BW values.
tolerance_note: All basis values at ≥60 dps via SnapPy high_precision().volume() or via mpmath clsin/catalan (algebraically exact). Whitehead Vol = 4G excluded as known Q-degeneracy with Borromean (8G = 2·4G).
interpretation: NO non-trivial small relation at 100 dps with max coeff 1000000 and tol 1e-50 over a 14-element high-precision SnapPy basis. K-theoretic identification requires content outside the H_3 + bridge-3 hyperbolic regime — either genuinely higher Heegaard genus or a non-NF representative. Three negative tiers now rule out the 'atlas + bridge-3' hypothesis.
